rows.description: City Council: agreement with Monarch Design Group for construction documents for the Crystal River Government Center Project, $1,009,640 (9.8% of general fund). Outcome not verified.

City Commission: Amendment No. 1 with Holtz Consulting Engineers, Inc. for Phase II Owner's Representative Services on the Northwest Neighborhood Improvements project, $5,043,306, for a revised agreement amount of $5,441,345.20. Outcome not verified.
rows.shortfall: Nov 12 (Florida Today): Delray Beach loss from Amendment 3 estimated at $21M; Commissioner Casale puts it closer to $11M.

rows.description: City Commission item 4E: approves the Flamingo Linear Park Signature Sculptures design proposal and a contract for commission and purchase of public art with Silverwater Creative LLC d/b/a Sijia Chen Studio, $143,000 from the Public Art project account. Outcome not verified.

CRA Board: Second Amendment for additional funding under the Tax Increment Revenue Funding Agreement (TIRFA) for the Ocean One Project at 114-222 N. Federal Highway. Amount not stated in item text. Outcome not verified.

Marco Island City Council: Resolution 26-49 authorizing issuance of up to $23,000,000 in General Obligation Bonds, Series 2027, payable from ad valorem taxes, to finance construction and transportation improvements. Outcome not verified.

Boynton Beach City Commission: Resolution R26-146 approves a Master Equipment Lease Purchase Agreement (Equipment Schedules 1 to 4) with Lease Servicing Center, Inc. dba NCL Government Capital via Sourcewell Contract 092424-NCL, $8,978,759.60 total. Outcome not verified.
Sunrise City Commission: awards Bid 26-47-03-MS, Springtree WWTP Odor Control and Sludge Holding Tank Improvements Project, to Daniel O'Connell's Sons, Inc., $6,758,700. Outcome not verified.

Boynton Beach City Commission: Resolution R26-047 approves a sole source agreement with FLOCK Group, Inc. for the Flock Safe City Initiative, up to $7,701,600 plus a 10% allowance of $770,160, over a ten-year term. Outcome not verified.

Sunrise City Commission: approves the MGA Sculpture Studio, LLC design "Checkered Flamingo" and a contract for commission and purchase of public art for the Flamingo Linear Park Signature Sculptures project; largest figure in item $150,000. Outcome not verified.
